summary.text: Samantha Lopez-Resendez is the Democratic candidate for Texas House District 50 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Republican Howard Olsen IV in a race with no incumbent.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she is running to protect and strengthen public education.

paragraphs.text: Lopez-Resendez also listed protecting reproductive health care and expanding affordable health care coverage among her key messages in the survey.

She said she supports workforce development, wildfire and flood mitigation, a reliable energy grid and infrastructure, and housing solutions for teachers, first responders, state employees and state retirees.
She added that she is also focused on gun safety through prevention and education and on protecting civil rights and democratic institutions.
